paragraphs.source_en: The cherry blossoms had fallen, carpeting the mountain beyond the window with petals. In the gathering dusk, even the cherry petals were gradually fading from sight. paragraphs.source_en: The night breeze blew softly. The stars winked tenderly above the dark mass of pine branches. The two of them could hear no sound and see nothing; only silence and burning heat remained around them. The fine spring night quietly opened for the two young people a doorway through which body and heart became one. Branches rustled behind the shrine, probably as a startled crow took flight.
